supplements.title: Epigallocatechin-3-Gallate Suppresses Glioma by Targeting Integrin αvβ3/FAK/ERK Signaling Axis and Matrix Metalloproteinases.
supplements.summary: Green tea compound EGCG suppresses glioma growth by blocking signaling pathways and works better combined with standard chemotherapy.

supplements.title: An Update on the Therapeutic Potential of Bixin and Norbixin Apocarotenoids.
supplements.summary: Bixin and norbixin, natural plant pigments, show promise treating metabolic disorders and various health conditions beyond their traditional cosmetic uses.

supplements.title: Codelivery of Doxorubicin and Carvacrol via a β-Cyclodextrin-Hyaluronic Acid Nanogel System for Targeted and Stimuli-Responsive Anticancer Therapy.
supplements.summary: Researchers developed nanogels delivering two drugs together to triple-negative breast cancer cells, improving treatment effectiveness and reducing toxicity.

supplements.title: Multi-omics analysis identifies CCNB1 as a cell cycle factor driving glioblastoma progression and its inhibition by resveratrol.
supplements.summary: Researchers found that CCNB1 protein drives glioblastoma growth and that resveratrol can suppress it, offering a potential new treatment approach.

supplements.title: Swertiamarin fails to induce cytotoxicity in colon cancer cell lines: Evidence against a direct anticancer effect.
supplements.summary: Swertiamarin, a plant compound, did not kill colon cancer cells in laboratory testing, suggesting it lacks direct anticancer effects.

supplements.title: Limonin induces ferroptosis in cervical squamous cell carcinoma by activating the expression of soluble epoxide hydrolase 2 protein.
supplements.summary: Limonin, a natural compound, stops cervical cancer growth by triggering a cell death process through a protein called EPHX2.

supplements.title: A novel matrine derivative exerts antitumor effects against hepatocellular carcinoma by inducing oxidative stress and DNA damage.
supplements.summary: A new matrine-based compound effectively kills hepatocellular carcinoma cells by causing DNA damage and oxidative stress.

supplements.title: The effect of ginseng extract on fatigue in cancer survivors: a randomized double-blind clinical trial.
supplements.summary: Ginseng extract reduced fatigue in gastrointestinal cancer survivors in a randomized clinical trial.

supplements.title: Weight Regain Reverses Caloric Restriction-Induced Benefits on the Insulin-IGF-1 Nutrient-Sensing Pathway: Post Hoc Analysis From the CALERIE-2 Randomized Controlled Trial.
supplements.summary: Regaining weight after calorie restriction reverses metabolic health improvements, including benefits to insulin and growth factor pathways.

supplements.title: Harnessing Sunlight Safely for Newborn Care: Balancing Risks and Benefits in Resource-Limited Settings.
supplements.summary: Filtered sunlight therapy safely treats newborn jaundice in resource-limited settings while providing vitamin D benefits.

supplements.title: PAK5-Mediated Suppression of β-Hydroxybutyrate Production Promotes Breast Cancer Metastasis and Can Be Overcome with Ketogenic Diet.
supplements.summary: A ketogenic diet boosts a protective molecule in breast cancer patients, blocking a protein pathway that drives metastasis.

supplements.title: Omega-3 fatty acids and human health: why strong claims remain on fragile consensus.
supplements.summary: Omega-3 supplements remain popular despite weak evidence for health benefits and concerns about product quality and effectiveness.

supplements.title: Crocin alleviates doxorubicin-mediated cardiotoxicity by activating PINK1-dependent cardiomyocyte mitophagy.
supplements.summary: Crocin protects the heart from damage caused by doxorubicin chemotherapy by activating a cellular cleanup process in heart cells.

supplements.title: Dihydroartemisinin targets GPX4 to induce autophagy-dependent ferroptosis and reduce radioresistance in triple-negative breast cancer.
supplements.summary: Dihydroartemisinin overcomes triple-negative breast cancer radioresistance by triggering ferroptosis through autophagy-dependent GPX4 degradation.

supplements.title: Vitamin B6 (Pyridoxal 5' Phosphate) antagonises carotid body P2X3 receptors in hypertension.
supplements.summary: Vitamin B6 blocks a specific receptor in the carotid body, potentially offering a new treatment approach for high blood pressure.

off_label.title: Metformin Blunts Vascular Insulin Sensitivity After Exercise Training in Adults at Risk for Metabolic Syndrome.
off_label.summary: Metformin may reduce the vascular health benefits normally gained from exercise training in people at metabolic risk.

off_label.title: A GCLC Inhibitor Enhances the Antitumor Efficacy of Glutathione Metabolic Pathway Inhibition in SMARCB1-Deficient Rhabdoid Tumors.
off_label.summary: GCLC inhibitors effectively kill SMARCB1-deficient rhabdoid tumors by depleting protective glutathione, and work better combined with other metabolic drugs.

off_label.title: LCN2 aggravates sepsis-induced ALI by inhibiting MUC1 to activate ER-stress-autophagy induced ferroptosis via lactate/MCT1/AMPK/mTOR axis.
off_label.summary: LCN2 protein worsens sepsis-induced lung injury through a specific cellular pathway; sorafenib drug shows promise as treatment.

off_label.title: Effect of orlistat and anti-androgen oral contraceptives on pregnancy outcomes in overweight or obese PCOS patients during comprehensive management.
off_label.summary: Overweight women with PCOS who received oral contraceptives and orlistat during preconception care showed improved pregnancy outcomes and live birth rates.

off_label.title: Glycohypoxia: a hypothesis linking chronic hyperglycemia to functional hypoxia and diabetic complications in type 2 diabetes.
off_label.summary: High blood sugar in type 2 diabetes reduces oxygen delivery to cells, causing complications; targeting this oxygen deficit offers new treatment approaches.

off_label.title: Chemoprevention of hepatocellular carcinoma by next-generation antipsychotic aripiprazole.
off_label.summary: Aripiprazole, an antipsychotic drug, prevents hepatocellular carcinoma development by reducing liver inflammation and fibrosis in preclinical models.

off_label.title: Drug repurposing in oncology: Bridging computational discovery to clinical application.
off_label.summary: Drug repurposing uses existing medications to fight cancer faster and cheaper than developing new drugs from scratch.

off_label.title: The mitochondrial gambit: Re-evaluating Antimycin A as a multi-pronged anti-cancer agent.
off_label.summary: Antimycin A, a mitochondrial inhibitor, kills cancer cells through multiple mechanisms including energy depletion, protein destruction, and stem cell targeting.

off_label.title: Delivering precision oncology in metastatic breast cancer: Clinical impact of comprehensive genomic profiling-The CATCH experience.
off_label.summary: Genomic testing identified actionable mutations in metastatic breast cancer, enabling personalized treatments that extended progression-free survival in one-third of patients.

off_label.title: An oncogenic, truncated FGFR1 variant cooperates with SPFQ/NONO to regulate gene transcription in FGFR1-driven leukaemia.
off_label.summary: A truncated FGFR1 protein drives leukemia by partnering with SFPQ and NONO proteins to control genes, offering a new treatment target.

off_label.title: DPP9 inhibition boosts antitumor immunity by disrupting BRISC-mediated PD-L1 expression in clear cell renal cell carcinoma.
off_label.summary: Blocking DPP9 reduces PD-L1 expression in kidney cancer, enhancing immune checkpoint therapy effectiveness and T cell tumor-killing ability.

off_label.title: Deciphering the groove-binding mode of dolutegravir with salmon sperm DNA through spectroscopic and molecular modelling approaches.
off_label.summary: Dolutegravir, an HIV drug, binds to DNA grooves and may be repositioned as a potential cancer treatment through targeted drug development strategies.

off_label.title: Enhanced antidepressant effects of fluoxetine combined with quercetin: studies in vitro and in vivo.
off_label.summary: Combining fluoxetine with quercetin, a natural compound, boosts antidepressant effects in laboratory and animal studies.

off_label.title: Risks of thrombosis and hemorrhage in concurrent use of anticoagulants and potential interacting prostate cancer agents.
off_label.summary: Prostate cancer drugs may dangerously interact with blood thinners, increasing risks of clots or bleeding.

off_label.title: Nitroxoline Enhances Radiosensitivity in Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer by Suppressing STAT3-AKT-MTOR Survival Signaling.
off_label.summary: Nitroxoline, an existing antimicrobial drug, enhances radiation therapy effectiveness in lung cancer by blocking survival pathways.

biomarkers.summary: Researchers propose targeting lactate dehydrogenase isozymes, especially LDH-C, as a selective metabolic strategy to combat cancer.

biomarkers.summary: GPR40 protein reduces glioblastoma sensitivity to chemotherapy by blocking ferroptosis, offering a new target to overcome drug resistance.

trials.summary: A new nanoplatform combines deep-tissue imaging with heat therapy and immune activation to treat resistant melanoma.

trials.summary: A combination of green tea, saffron, DHA, and α-lipoic acid protects dopamine-producing brain cells from Parkinson's-related damage in laboratory tests.
